segments.name: Safety Products
segments.description: Designs and markets popularly priced safety and electrical products to retailers and the electrical distribution trade.
segments.evidence: We also market door chimes, ventilation products, ground fault circuit interrupters (GFCI's), and other electrical devices.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by retailers, distributors and electrical distribution trade customers for safety and security products sold under purchase orders or contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's primary source of revenue is the sale of safety and security products based upon purchase orders or contracts with customers.

changes.text: In 2025, the company sold its smoke and carbon monoxide alarm business to Feit Electric Company, Inc.
changes.evidence: On May 22, 2025, the Asset Purchase Agreement with Feit was completed and the Company recorded a gain from this transaction of $ 2,820,668 .

changes.text: In 2025, the company formed Universal DeFi LLC as a new venture pursuing a tokenization platform and node operations on the Ault Blockchain.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, we formed a wholly owned subsidiary called Universal DeFi LLC ("Universal DeFi") as a new venture to diversify the business and explore new paths for revenue and stockholder value.
